## Terms

### Write Concern

- **Write Concern** · self — Write concern specifies the acknowledgment a write requests. Its `w` field selects a node count or tag rule, `j` requests on-disk journal acknowledgment, and `wtimeout` bounds waiting for the requested write concern. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/write-concern/
